changelog: Initial open-source release. One-click OpenClaw subagent timeout configurator. Three preset profiles (quick/normal/patient) tune the three related fields atomically with TTL constraint validation (ttlMinutes*60 >= runTimeoutSeconds). Auto-backup before write, optional gateway auto-restart, --dry-run preview, --custom values, --config path override. Zero pip dependencies, Python stdlib only.
